description:
Cause Kami of Whispered Hopes to become an artifact using Memnarch.
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Kami of Whispered Hopes
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater
